race.title: Betfair Chase (Grade 1) (Registered As The Lancashire Chase) (GBB Race)
race.verdict: GREY DAWNING can emulate Kauto Star, Cue Card, Bristol de Mai and Royale Pagaille and become the fifth back-to-back winner of this race. Like the selection, Affordale Fury has a good record fresh and last season's Savills winner can give Dan Skelton's charge most to do. Jagwar , who retains the cheekpieces he wore for the first time in the Grand National, looks best of the remainder. GREY DAWNING (IRE) AFFORDALE FURY (IRE) JAGWAR (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Grey Dawning (1/1), Affordale Fury (11/4), Jagwar (7/1), Gorgeous Tom (10/1), Salver (10/1), Handstands (16/1), Konfusion (66/1)
